issues.display_title: Issue #1437: [Post Detail] 19. Pick of the Day Label
issues.main_description_html:
[Post Detail] Pick of the Day Label Report and Documentation

Tested by :

QA (Quality Assurance) @ekosy9

Project :

Panorra App @lundara02

Description of Feature :

The "Pick of the Day Label" is a feature designed to highlight a specific piece of content as a top recommendation for the day.

Device :

  • AMD Ryzen 3 4300U (8GB) Windows 10
  • Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-4570 (8GB) Windows 10
  • Android 14 (8GB) - Samsung SM-A235F

Main Functions :

Title Scenario
Description : "Pick of the Day Label" is a Panorra app feature designed to label content.
Actor : User & Viewer
Interface : Post Detail
Pre-Condition : Homepage
Basic Flow : Actor System
- Actors on the homepage (For You, Recent and Nearest)
- Actors taps the post "View Details" button
- Navigate to detail post
- Show Pick of the Day labels in post details next to the post time.
Correct scenario and corresponding result : Labels displayed on posts
Correct scenario and incorrect result : not a POTD post
Incorrect scenario and corresponding result : Validate with Pick of the Day broadcast
Incorrect scenario and non-conforming result : not a POTD post and Validate with Pick of the Day broadcast
Feature Finish Date : 24 July 2024
Previous Flow : On the homepage, Actors can see various posts. When a Actors taps the "View Details" button on a post, they are navigated to the post's detail view. In the post details, the "Pick of the Day" label is displayed next to the post time, highlighting this content as the top recommendation of the day.
24 July 2024

Others Flow : ✅

No. Alternative Flow Status Description
1. Post detail POTD via Most popular page Pass Main function
2. Post detail POTD via Search page Pass Main function
3. Post detail POTD via Notification page Pass Main function
4. Post detail POTD via Profile page Pass Main function

Basic Flow Video Report : ✅

potd_smoke_test_clean.mp4

  • Ensure actors when visiting POTD post details are labeled POTD
  • Validates only certain users can broadcast POTDs
  • Validates regular posts and POTD labeled posts match the POTD notification

Test Case: ✅

"A test case is a document or plan that describes a series of steps that must be followed and conditions that must be met to test a software component or system. Test cases are used to test whether the software functions according to the specifications and needs that have been determined beforehand. Test cases help ensure that the software can operate correctly, identify problems or defects, and verify that the software can meet user needs. verify that the software can meet user or business needs. or business needs."

No. Scenario Method Type Final Result Status Remarks
1. Actor accesses detailed posts labeled POTD White Box Positive Accepted Pass Main function
2. Actors accesses detailed posts without labeled POTD Grey Box Positive Accepted Pass not a POTD post
3. Actor adds a POTD label to the post Black Box Negative Rejected Pass Validation with account super user admin

Regression Testing : ✅

"Regression testing is a type of software testing performed to ensure that new changes applied to code or systems do not affect or break pre-existing functionality. The main goal of regression testing is to verify that changes or updates applied to the software do not result in "regressions," i.e. new problems or errors appearing in areas that were previously working properly."

Pick of the Day Label
No. Period Version Code Evidence Status Description
1. 24 July 2024 v1.1.16.3 None Pass Running well

Smoke Testing : ✅

"Smoke testing is a type of software testing that is performed as an initial check to ensure that the software or system has been installed correctly and can function at a basic level. level. This test aims to identify basic problems that may occur after a software installation or update before conducting further testing. If any issues arise during smoke testing, the software is considered "failed," and further testing is postponed until the problem is fixed. further testing is postponed until the issue is fixed."
